'''1997 Corellia Regionals (Columbus)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Corellia region (Wisconsin, Michigan, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Corellia)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 19 July 1997
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio
